meta.name: prisma-postgres-setup
meta.description: Set up a new Prisma Postgres database and connect it to a local project using the Management API. Use when asked to "set up a database", "create a Prisma Postgres project", "get a connection string", "connect my app to Prisma Postgres", or "provision a database".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开通数据库并接入本地项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在本地项目中快速接入一个 Postgres 数据库。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a Postgres database for your local project.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a Postgres database connected to your local project quickly.

howto.what: 触发后,Claude 会新建一个 Prisma Postgres 数据库,拿到连接地址,再把本地项目配置好:安装依赖、写入环境配置、建立数据模型、生成迁移文件和客户端,最后测试确认能连上。
howto.when: 当用户要求“设置数据库”“创建 Prisma Postgres 项目”或“获取连接字符串”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个应用连上 Prisma Postgres 数据库。
say.note: 会创建数据库并配好本地连接。

say.text: 新建一个 Prisma Postgres 项目,给我连接字符串。
帮我搭好 Prisma Postgres 环境,先建一张任务表。
say.note: 会生成迁移文件并验证连通。

howto.what_en: On trigger, Claude creates a Prisma Postgres database, gets the connection string, and configures the local project: installs dependencies, writes env config, sets up the data model, runs migrations, generates the client, then verifies the connection.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to “set up a database”, “create a Prisma Postgres project”, or “get a connection string”, etc.

say_en.text: Connect this app to a Prisma Postgres database.
say_en.note: It creates the database and configures the local connection.

say_en.text: Create a Prisma Postgres project and give me the connection string.
say_en.note: You will be asked to choose a region.

say_en.text: Set up a Prisma Postgres environment and start with a tasks table.
say_en.note: It generates the migration and verifies connectivity.
